svg.aria-label: Bupples. Live on the App Store and Google Play. Split the bill, skip the awkward follow-up. Scan a receipt, tap who had what, and Bupples works out who owes whom. Built with Flutter, Firebase and Vertex AI. The screenshot shows the profile, accent editor and settings screens.
